content.title: Snowboard Route Escalation | Equipment Lock, Rail and Aerial Payoff
content.summary: A surveyor completes rail, turns and one half-turn jump on a fixed course. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Adult identity and equipment remain fixed. + The course direction is established before tricks. + Each obstacle has a visible entry and exit. + Speed and height escalate monotonically. + The terminal jump preserves board-body attachment through landing.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one adult mountain surveyor with a red helmet, ivory shell and cobalt snowboard at a marked snow course. Follow her across one low silver rail and require a clean two-foot landing on the same board. End with one straight ramp jump and a single half-turn before the same board reconnects to the landing slope.
